content.headline: Hallucination Clinic — when AI sounds right but is wrong
content.body: AI can write something that sounds perfect but is completely wrong. You are still the signing authority — always verify before you send.
bullets: Never publish AI-generated budget figures, legal sections, or citizen names without checking the original file
Compare: an ungrounded AI answer vs a RAG answer with page citations
Golden rule: human-in-the-loop is non-negotiable for government work
